definitions.explanation: A collection of people or things organized together.
A group of students studying together.
Used as a counter for sets or pairs of items.

examples.japanese: チームを{組|く}んで{試合|しあい}に{出|で}る。
examples.english: To form a team and enter the match.

examples.japanese: この{組|くみ}は{強|つよ}いチームだ。
examples.english: This group is a strong team.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}らは{犯罪|はんざい}{組|くみ}のメンバーだと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: They are said to be members of a crime organization.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は３{年|ねん}２{組|くみ}です。
{隣|となり}の{組|くみ}の{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}ぶ。
examples.english: I play with a friend from the next class.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{同|おな}じ{組|くみ}になれてうれしい。
examples.english: I'm happy we're in the same class this year.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}{組|ぐみ}で{練習|れんしゅう}する。
examples.notes: [Note: 組 becomes ぐみ when used as a suffix]

examples.japanese: このグラス{一組|ひとくみ}ください。
examples.english: One set of these glasses, please.

examples.japanese: {茶碗|ちゃわん}と{皿|さら}の{二組|ふたくみ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought two sets of bowls and plates.

notes:
{組|くみ} refers to organized groups or sets.

AS SCHOOL CLASS:
- ３{年|ねん}２{組|くみ} (Year 3, Class 2)
- {同|おな}じ{組|くみ} (same class)

AS SUFFIX (becomes ぐみ):
- {二人|ふたり}{組|ぐみ} (pair, duo)
- {三人|さんにん}{組|ぐみ} (trio)
- {親子|おやこ}{組|ぐみ} (parent-child pair)

AS SET:
- {一組|ひとくみ} (one set)
- {茶碗|ちゃわん}{一組|ひとくみ} (a set of tea bowls)

RELATED WORDS:
- {組|く}む (to form a group)
- {組合|くみあい} (union, association)
